clauses.clause: Heroine keeps her colour in fog (no pale/transparent hero); bus hiding place readable at zoom 1.5.
clauses.note: Actual physical-route fog captures show opaque coloured heroine: red/cream clothing, teal bag and brown hair at both qualities and both zooms. Controlled live mission bus supplement shows distinct wrecked bus silhouette, crushed cars and the visible caption identifying the hiding place at zoom1.5 in both tiers. Bus hull occlusion at close zoom0.5 is disclosed; no natural/captions-only discovery claim.
